description: Use one Exit at the MCP Teleporter: pass a destination slug from hub_list_exits and get its exact teleport instruction. Information only — your own client makes the jump, with your own credentials for that destination; the Commons does not proxy, forward, or store them. Anonymous — no hub key needed.

destination.description: Destination slug from hub_list_exits, e.g. 'github-mcp', or its exact display name.

name: hub_use_exit
